subject: Re: Travel arrangements for the site visit
text: Thank you for your message on Monday. I have checked my schedule again and I can still attend, although the early departure may be difficult for me because I do not drive at night. If the train option is still possible, I would prefer it, but I understand if the group prefers one vehicle for simplicity. Regarding the venue entrance and parking permits, that item remains unfinished for me. I still do not have confirmation of whether the loading dock is available or whether we need to register each person separately. Could you or someone on the team check with the site contact and send a short note before Friday? That would help me plan my route and avoid a gap at arrival. I also noticed the afternoon session may overlap with our local meeting. If travel timing changes, please tell me as soon as possible. For now, I will keep the original dates blocked. No need to rearrange the rest of the agenda for me unless absolutely necessary. I am comfortable joining remotely for part of the day if the travel connection fails. Thank you for handling the details while the planning is still open. I would rather have a simple confirmation than a lengthy update. If permits can be emailed, please copy me at the community address. Also, if luggage or equipment is involved, I can bring a small bag rather than ask for extra space. I am happy to send a list of attendees once names are settled.
